{{short description|Polish mathematician}}
[[File:Kazimierz_Abramowicz.jpg|thumb|Kazimierz Abramowicz]]
'''Kazimierz Abramowicz''' (1889&ndash;1936) was a Polish [[mathematician]] and professor at the [[University of Poznan]].<ref>{{citation
 |last=Dobrowolski 
 |first=Wiaczesław A. 
 |issue=3 
 |journal=Kwart. Hist. Nauki I Tech. 
 |language=Polish 
 |mr=0472382 
 |pages=547–551 
 |trans-title=Kazimierz Abramowicz in Kiev. A contribution to Polish–Ukrainian scientific and cultural relations 
 |title=Kazimierz Abramowicz w Kijowie: przyczynek do polsko-ukraińskich związków naukowo-kulturalnych 
 |url=http://yadda.icm.edu.pl/yadda/element/bwmeta1.element.element-mhp-d887d0b6-300e-4499-a02c-945bc0c48b3e/c/Wiaczeslaw_A_Dobrowolski_-_kazimierz_abram_547-551.pdf 
 |volume=19 
 |year=1974 
 |url-status=dead 
 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140725221747/http://yadda.icm.edu.pl/yadda/element/bwmeta1.element.element-mhp-d887d0b6-300e-4499-a02c-945bc0c48b3e/c/Wiaczeslaw_A_Dobrowolski_-_kazimierz_abram_547-551.pdf 
 |archivedate=2014-07-25 
}}.</ref><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=suoSAQAAMAAJ|title=Rocznik Polskiego tow. matematycznego|date=1930|pages=146|language=pl}}</ref>
He worked in the field of theory of [[analytic functions]], in particular [[hypergeometric function]]s.<ref name="h381">{{cite web | last=Maligranda | first=L. | title=Kazimierz Abramowicz (1888-1936) | website=Semantic Scholar | date=2017 | url=https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/Kazimierz-Abramowicz-%281888-1936%29-Maligranda/ef8c79e9d94eac91dc96e038fbd5cdfdb12ebced | access-date=2025-02-24}}</ref>
